text: S606 follows S603/S604's unresolved waistband grade-path identity with one known, documented read-only getter already observed working in this exact CLO build: GetPatternInputInformation, queried once for each of the three current patterns. It will compare literal returned coordinates to S567 source CUT/SEW and fail closed if identity is non-unique. No selection, pattern, grade, project, or DXF changes; all V03 acceptance stays unchanged.
